_comment: bmad-loop hook relay. The path is RELATIVE on purpose. bmad-loop init writes it as "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.bmad-loop/bmad_loop_hook.py", which is POSIX shell expansion: on Windows PowerShell $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is a shell variable rather than an environment variable, expands to empty, and every hook died with exit 2 on C:\.bmad-loop\bmad_loop_hook.py. The orchestrator then never saw a session end and waited out the full session_timeout_min on every story. Hooks run with the project root as cwd, so a relative path needs no expansion and stays correct on every shell and OS. Use $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR only if this ever has to become absolute, and note that form is PowerShell-only.
